provenance.asset_description: : Illustration by Rubén Pomares. A small girl stands on the seashore casting a spell, and electricity arcs from her hands to a group of water elementals attacking her. A pink dragon, twice her size, stands between her and the oncoming elementals, shielding her from attack.
